## Checklist

- [ ] One file per skill in `content/skills/`, named `<slug>.md`
- [ ] It is public and it works. I tried it, or I linked proof (docs, demo, README).
- [ ] The tagline says what it does in one plain sentence. No hype.
- [ ] One primary category: the job it does, not the tool it uses
- [ ] Every link is `https://` and opens
- [ ] `status` is `community` (only the curator sets `verified`)
- [ ] I did not edit `metrics` (a nightly job fills them)
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
